Each version below is a published PC printing; card-image dates are the upload dates of the card-size image (<code>large</code> folder) in the PC's image repository. Every visibly different printing is a separate version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026); pixel-identical re-uploads are not. The image uses the PC's short game-text symbols: the pilot symbol with “2.” stands for “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots.” and “▲ Jyn” for “take Jyn into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” (the wording of [[K-2SO (Kay-Tuesso) (Errata 2)]]). The PC also published the same picture as <code>k2sokaytuesso_ai.gif</code> (same commits, pixel-identical). The PC's card data has no entry for this Alternate Image card (checked: swccg-card-json and the Holotable CDF files, October 2026); the page follows the printed image. '''Errata mark:''' the first image of this Alternate Image card already prints “E1” (it follows the errata count of the card's text); recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
